LapakVendor.title: LapakVendor
LapakVendor.description: Public vendor portal document synced from the Lapak Kita Admin app for a specific consignor/seller.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the Lapak Kita Admin who owns this vendor.

vendorCode.description: Unique vendor portal code in LPK-XXXXXX format matching the document ID.

localSellerId.description: Local Room Seller ID on the Admin device.

sellerName.description: Display name of the vendor/kitchen (Nama Dapur Penyetor).

adminFeeType.description: Active admin commission fee type applied to this vendor.

adminFeeValue.description: Active admin fee amount (Rupiah if FIXED, percentage 0-100 if PERCENTAGE).

summaryTotalStock.description: Read-only total remaining stock count across the vendor's products.

summaryTotalSold.description: Read-only total units sold for this vendor.

summaryUnpaidBalance.description: Read-only total unpaid settlement balance owed to the vendor.

products.description: Bounded list (max 100) of the vendor's products with current stock and revenue share details.

lastProcessedSubmissionId.description: ID of the last vendor web submission processed by the Admin app.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the vendor document was created (clients must write FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest sync (clients must write FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

VendorAuthSecret.title: VendorAuthSecret
VendorAuthSecret.description: Admin-only private secret document storing the writeToken used to authorize Web Penyetor submissions.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning Admin.

writeToken.description: Secret write token shared exclusively with the vendor via their personal portal link.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the secret was created (clients must write FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the secret was last updated (clients must write FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

VendorSubmission.title: VendorSubmission
VendorSubmission.description: Write-authenticated submission from the public Web Penyetor containing new products, product edits, and daily stock deliveries.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning Admin (matched against parent LapakVendor).

newProducts.description: Bounded list (max 50) of new products submitted by the vendor.

editedProducts.description: Bounded list (max 50) of product edits submitted by the vendor.

stockAdditions.description: Bounded list (max 50) of daily stock deliveries submitted by the vendor.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when submitted (clients must write FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when last updated (clients must write FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/lapak_vendors/{vendorCode}.description: Vendor portal state synced by Admin and read by the corresponding vendor using their unique vendorCode.

/lapak_vendors/{vendorCode}/private/{doc.description: Private admin-only subcollection storing writeToken at docId='auth' to verify vendor submissions without exposing the token.

/lapak_vendor_submissions/{submissionId}.description: Vendor web portal submissions for new products, edits, and daily stock deliveries, listened in real-time by the owning Admin.
